working_window_selection: Chosen after inspecting the four-, six-, and ten-week results; exploratory. The original ten-week main comparisons and all sensitivity results are retained.
weighting: Equal weight per restaurant; each restaurant has a review-count-weighted rating mean within each period and must be observed in both periods
inference: OLS on restaurant rating changes, standard errors clustered by county; two-sided t test with county-cluster degrees of freedom

original_election_comparison.ME_universe: Original 135 exact-date election-cohort IDs, with 134 eligible in complete weeks
